name: Jasper
tagline: AI platform for branded marketing content and campaign workflows

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Pro listed at $69/month monthly or $59/month billed yearly.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.limits: 1 seat; 2 brand voices; 5 knowledge assets; 3 audiences; 30+ languages.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.limits: Unlimited brand voices, knowledge assets, and audiences; API, agents, governance, and custom seats.

pricing.billingTerms: monthly + annual for Pro; Business is custom
pricing.hiddenCosts: Additional Pro seats cost extra, and Copyscape plagiarism checks are a separately paid add-on.

verdictSummary: A branded prompt library over an LLM is buildable, but Jasper's paid value is brand memory, workflow templates, governance, collaboration, and marketing-specific agents.
coreLoopDIY: Store brand voice/docs, provide marketing templates/agents, call an LLM, and organize outputs by campaign.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay to scale marketing output while keeping brand consistency and approval workflows.

priorArt.name: LibreChat
priorArt.desc: Open-source AI chat/workspace UI that can be extended with prompt presets and model routin

alternatives.name: AnythingLLM
alternatives.desc: A local-first AI desk with reusable agents, documents, memory, and workflows; less campaign theatre, more settings.

facts.install: Desktop installer for macOS/Windows/Linux, or Docker for a self-hosted web instance
facts.engines: Local llama.cpp models plus Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI and many cloud APIs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, Azure, OpenRouter and Mistral
facts.dataFormat: Desktop data stays in the app's local storage; self-hosted data is stored in the mounted server storage and chosen vector database (LanceDB by default), while prompts sent to cloud models leave the machine
facts.gapVsPaid: It can hold brand documents and reusable agents, but it lacks Jasper's managed brand governance, campaign workflows, approvals, and marketing-team controls.
facts.setupBlocker: The installer is easy, but useful results still require downloading a local model or supplying a model-provider API key

alternatives.name: Jan
alternatives.desc: A desktop ChatGPT-shaped box with local models and reusable assistants; excellent at prompts, blissfully unaware of your marketing calendar.

facts.install: Download the macOS, Windows or Linux desktop installer
facts.engines: Built-in local inference via llama.cpp/llama-server plus OpenAI-compatible APIs and connectors such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Mistral and OpenRouter
facts.dataFormat: Threads, assistants, settings and downloaded model files live in Jan's local data folder; only requests sent to configured cloud providers leave the machine
facts.gapVsPaid: It is a general assistant with saved instructions, not Jasper's coordinated campaign workspace with brand controls and team operations.
facts.setupBlocker: Local use requires downloading a multi-gigabyte model and enough RAM; cloud use requires an API key

alternatives.name: Open WebUI
alternatives.desc: A self-hosted AI workbench with saved prompts, knowledge, web search, and multi-model comparison; powerful, not especially house-trained.

facts.install: Run the official Docker image, install the Python package, or deploy with Kubernetes
facts.engines: Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API, including LM Studio, vLLM, Groq, Mistral and OpenRouter; additional speech, image and search providers
facts.dataFormat: By default, chats and account data live in a local SQLite webui.db, uploads in a data/uploads directory and embeddings in the configured vector store; PostgreSQL and object storage are optional
facts.gapVsPaid: It can approximate brand-aware drafting, but not Jasper's packaged marketing workflows, governance, collaboration, and campaign management.
facts.setupBlocker: A non-expert must install Docker or a compatible Python environment, mount persistent storage correctly, and separately provide Ollama or an API endpoint

notes: Good paid-wrapper debate: buildable core, but organizational workflow can justify paying.
prompt:
Build me a personal marketing-copy generator to replace Jasper. Requirements:

- A local web app: Node + Express + better-sqlite3 on localhost:4850, plain
  server-rendered forms, no frontend framework.
- A brand/ folder of Markdown files: voice.md (tone rules, banned words),
  audience.md, product.md. Every generation prepends these to the prompt
  automatically.
- Template library in SQLite: blog outline, landing-page hero, product description,
  cold email, tweet thread. Each template is a prompt with {{variables}} filled in
  from a small form.
- Calls the Anthropic or OpenAI API (key and model name in .env), streams into the
  page, and always produces 3 variants side by side.
- Every output saved with template, inputs, chosen variant, and a campaign label;
  past outputs browsable and searchable by campaign.
- A rewrite box: paste any draft, get it back in my brand voice.
- Everything stays on my machine except the LLM calls. No accounts, no telemetry.
- Out of scope: team collaboration, approval workflows, and multi-writer brand
  governance. This is a one-person tool.
- README: .env keys and how to tune the brand files, that is where the quality lives.
